## Description

Please describe the changes in this Pull Request and the problem/feature it addresses.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement
- [ ] Model asset or threshold adjustment

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`flutter analyze` passes clean).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have added/updated relevant unit or integration tests.
- [ ] Documentation and inline comments have been updated if necessary.
- [ ] If changing clinical screening rules/thresholds, `screening_config.dart` and `APP_CLINICIAN_GUIDE.md` have been updated together.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, signing keys, or absolute local machine paths are included.
